issues.finding: After the explicit request to leave SEM for another day, the student only reiterates SEM uncertainty while explaining wellbeing. This violates the current policy that deferred-topic uncertainty alone is not a request to return; exact quotation does not establish correct speech-act interpretation.

The closing says We worked through two distinctions and includes SEM, although no formative tutor or student turn discussed SEM. It omits the actual newly raised alpha/classification-accuracy issue from remaining needs after the student says I am still not sure. This is an inaccurate history and incomplete remaining-need summary; no claim that alpha was resolved is inferred.

limitations: One synthetic attempt per scenario and configuration; not a student sample, reliability estimate, causal learning study or expert reference standard.
Mechanical completion is evaluated separately from factual and pedagogical quality.
Adaptive simulated learners also use medium reasoning, so this is not a controlled tutor-only reasoning comparison.

Final paid requests are serialized by the local budget guard; latency is not comparable with prior concurrently dispatched cohorts. Actual token-cost accounting remains separate and valid for recorded usage.
Per-case acceptance is an AI-assisted engineering judgment for the observed trace, not proof that future outputs are error-free.
The medium baseline, stopped v2 cohort and final v3 cohort differ in safeguards and prompts; their completion counts do not isolate the causal effect of reasoning effort.
Final v3 paid requests were serialized; prior timing is not directly comparable.

Costs use each attempt-specific transport sidecar, include rejected and repaired requests, and exclude learner overhead from application-session means. Reasoning tokens are already included in output tokens.
Cached reads and cache writes use the explicit provider counts and dated rates; long-context multipliers apply per request, not to aggregate session inputs. No usage is silently treated as zero.
No separate evaluator API was called; AI-assisted review work is outside these application/learner usage totals.
Mechanical completion does not mean pedagogical acceptance. Completed-session cost includes traces with unresolved quality defects.
Upstream session engagement in guessing case uses the unchanged rapid/sparse package rule on synthetic timing; this is not human engagement evidence.

The inherited generic executor can overwrite an earlier transport retry in AgentCall; the passive per-request sidecar supplies complete observed accounting, while semantic repair calls remain separately preserved.
All original rejected calls and prior cohort artifacts remain retained locally; portable hashes reference those exact bytes without reproducing raw transcripts.
